actions.name: Register on the VipLime website using this link:
Enter your username, email address, password, and password confirmation.
A confirmation link will then be sent to your email address. Follow the link to verify your email address.
Next, log in to the website using the credentials you provided during registration.

name: Activating the trial period and/or purchasing a package

actions.name: VipLime lets you activate a free 24-hour trial once, at any time you choose. To activate the trial, open the Telegram bot:
After the 24-hour period ends, if you want to continue watching, you will need to top up your balance and purchase a package. To do this, go to "Account" and select "Top up balance".

Once your balance has been topped up, the service is activated automatically. Your subscription is also renewed automatically as long as you have a positive balance. The payment is charged once a month.

name: Copying the playlist to your device's media player

actions.name:
Open your account and select "Playlists".
Then select the "HLS (M3U8)" tab.
Next, choose the playlist that matches your internet connection speed and quality, then copy it. You can simply select the link and press Ctrl+C.
Save your playlist URL in a file named link.txt, take a photo of it, or save it anywhere convenient.
Do not share your credentials (key or playlist) with third parties. If simultaneous viewing from different devices is detected, your account will be blocked!
